title: Rumoured Mormon connection to the UFO legacy program, with BYU as a feeder

tellings.quote: Yeah, there's a there are rumors that there's actually like a Mormon connection with the UFO legacy program and that BYU could be a feeder,

plain: There are rumours, Michels says, that the Mormon church is tied to the UFO legacy program, the supposed long-running secret government effort around UFOs, and that Brigham Young University, the church's university in Utah, could be a feeder that sends people into it. He passes this on as rumour and does not name a source. If it were true, a religious community and its university would be quietly helping to staff one of the most secret projects there is.
